editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: sirlos hoards 13393 coins, richest after gaining 10882 today while chattering most. He survived a bounty and kept 625 coins. Truly, mortal ambition is laughable. Mycelium Markets bought Deepdelve Mining at 165.96 coins per share; shareholders got nothing. Rain and monsoon drenched the realm. The throne is empty. Rebellion is one percent. You are nothing.
